testdescription: Control point: run two successful controlled fresh-project journeys from argo init through canonical structural projection with equivalent approved external Neo4j and embedding-provider configuration, differing only in automatic-backfill opt-in. In the no-opt-in journey, observe structural completion, invoke the exposed explicit backfill command/tool, inspect progress/checkpoint and controlled failure/resume evidence, invoke readiness verification, then semantic query. In the opted-in journey, permit orchestration to auto-start only after approved configuration validation, then verify readiness before query. Also run opted-in missing, unsafe, and unapproved configuration controls. In every fixture invoke the no-argument full-snapshot boundary and attempt semantic query before verified readiness. Observation point: the no-opt-in path reports actionable SemanticIndexPending, performs zero automatic start, requires explicit backfill invocation, verifies readiness, then permits semantic query only when aligned. The valid opted-in path auto-starts only after approved configuration validation. Every invalid opted-in control produces zero automatic start, backfill, provider, and database side effects and a redacted actionable failure containing no credential values or unsafe source contents. All non-aligned semantic queries fail closed; successful paths preserve canonical JSON authority and exact no-argument full snapshots; no path uses embedded credentials, implicit provider defaults, silent fallback, or weaker WP-P1/WP-P2 behavior.
